entities.name: Query phosphate acyltransferase
observations: 348 aa protein; calculated molecular mass 37,592.6 Da and theoretical pI 6.84.
Exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt Q82U61 from Nitrosomonas europaea; alignment identity and coverage are 100%.
Pfam FA_synthesis domain PF02504.21 spans residues 4–319.
Strongly supported function is phosphate:acyl-[acyl carrier protein] acyltransferase, EC 2.3.1.274.
Catalyzes reversible transfer of an acyl group from acyl-ACP to phosphate, producing acyl phosphate and holo-ACP; annotated not to use acyl-CoA.
Annotated in fatty-acid biosynthesis and phospholipid metabolism; cytoplasmic and possibly membrane-associated through PlsY.
Reviewed homologs are annotated as homodimers.
Sequence-derived instability index is 55.9; this is a computational estimate and should not be overinterpreted.

entities.name: Q82U61
observations: Reviewed UniProt phosphate acyltransferase from Nitrosomonas europaea; exact sequence match to the query.
Annotated as a homodimer and cytoplasmic, with possible membrane association through PlsY.

entities.name: Acyl-ACP phosphate formation
observations: Reaction: fatty acyl-[ACP] + phosphate ⇌ acyl phosphate + holo-[ACP].
Mapped to Rhea RHEA:42292; enzyme classification EC 2.3.1.274.
Reference annotations specify acyl-ACP as donor and exclude acyl-CoA as donor.

entities.name: Phospholipid metabolism
observations: The query protein is annotated in phospholipid metabolism and fatty-acid biosynthesis.
